conditional_findings.first_contract: A required in-grid support query should distinguish a numerical support computation failure from genuinely absent support, or admission should reject geometry that cannot support the operation.
conditional_findings.trace: Static source-level example, not constructed: SceneTerrain::from_heightmap(2,2, 1e-30, [0,0,0,0]) has finite positive normal f32 scale, finite extents, four finite heights and stride1, satisfying the shown public admission checks. ScenePlanPoint::ORIGIN falls inside the one sampled cell, whose flat tangents are (s,0,0) and (0,0,s). Under ordinary IEEE f32 arithmetic their cross-product vertical component s*s is approximately 1e-60 and rounds to zero. Pinned glam source computes that cross and its Vec3 length; pinned bevy_math Dir3::new rejects a zero length. SurfaceHit::from_geometry maps the error to None, height_at propagates None, and required_height_at labels it MissingSupport. The landform edge helper calls required_height_at, while garden projection has a separately named MissingSoil mapping. No heightmap, query, Dir3, field, scene or product operation was executed.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: Current reassessment of original059 Lens8 observation with independently attributed Lens12 native and later connected records; not a new historical finding or checkpoint3821. TacticalSceneInput validate_grid requires spacing in 0.25–2000 metres, excluding this tiny public-API example from that validated input boundary. SceneTerrain public constructor itself has no such minimum. Dir3 uses eager then_some(value / length); pinned glam Vec3 scalar division has no shown assertion. glam sqrt selects std or libm according to features, and its no-backend implementation is unimplemented; no actual feature resolution is claimed. The std source and libm generic path support sqrt(0)=0 under their respective assumptions; architecture-specific libm dispatch and all selected compile configurations remain unproven. No ordinary production scale, runtime incident, collider behavior or exact alias is asserted.
